name: devin-honcho
description: Persistent cross-session memory for Devin CLI via Honcho — lifecycle hooks capture your turns and recall context on demand (unofficial community plugin)

setup.notice: Requires a Honcho API key (or self-hosted Honcho) and Node >= 18 on your PATH. Configuration is shared with the other Honcho integrations via ~/.honcho/config.json.
steps: Run `honcho init` to save your API key, or reuse the existing ~/.honcho/config.json from another Honcho integration
Bootstrap with `npx -p github:mikeng-io/honcho-plugins devin-honcho install` to seed hosts.devin and stage the hooks
Install with `devin plugins install mikeng-io/honcho-plugins#packages/devin-honcho`, then start a new session
